title: WHO Medical Product Alert N°8/2022: Substandard (contaminated) METHOTREX 50mg identified in the WHO Eastern Mediterranean region
reviewedBy: Claude Code, transcribed from the WHO alert PDF; pending review by Pranshu Rastogi

sources.label: WHO alert PDF with the annex of affected batches

notes: Identified in Yemen and Lebanon. WHO: the batch "was intended to be sold exclusively on the Indian market"; the stated manufacturer confirmed the batch, manufacturing and expiry combination matches its records.

rows.manufacturer: CELON LABORATORIES PVT LTD (Telangana, India); marketed by RMPL PHARMA LLP, Mumbai
